reading: The sketch is a dark hero/landing section for a "The Long Walk" story site: a lavender nav bar, a masked gradient orb, a serif headline with an italic peach word, a lavender body paragraph, a mint eyebrow label, a vertical progress rail with four stop labels, a scrolling giant-number ticker, and three rotated full-width color bands at the bottom with a "SCROLL" prompt — all specified precisely by the typed notes.
